definitions.explanation: Earlier than a specified time or event.
At some time in the past.

examples.japanese: {以前|いぜん}⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいました→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I used to live here before.
It's a story from more than 3 years ago.

examples.japanese: {以前|いぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: To restore to the previous state.

⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{以前|いぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧。

examples.english: I used to be a smoker.

notes:
{以前|いぜん} indicates "before" in time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {以前|いぜん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (before, formerly)
- X{以前|いぜん} (before X, prior to X)
- {以前|いぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (former ~, previous ~)
- {以前|いぜん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from before, for a while)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {以前|いぜん}: before (formal, specific point)
- ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: before, in front (common, general)
- ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧: once, formerly (literary)

USAGE:
- Different from ⟦{依然|いぜん}→依然：01719_izen⟧ (still, as before) - same reading, different kanji
